records.titleEn: NM-088-26 · Denmark. Notice to all ships in the Baltic Sea, Kattegat, and Skagerrak.
records.bodyIs:
Notice to all ships in the Baltic Sea, Kattegat, and Skagerrak
NATO Shipping Center informs about the mission, "Baltic Sentry", which aims to increase the protection of critical undesea infrastructure in the Skagerrak, Kattegat and the Baltic Sea area. This initiative involves increased activity with naval vessels, aircraft and drones.
NATO encourages vessels observing suspicious behaviour or incidents to report to NATO Shipping Center on +44 1923-956574 or report incidents via email to: info@shipping.nato.int .
Further information can be found on the NATO Shipping Centre website: www.shipping.nato.int
Source: DEMA 4 February 2026
